investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Northant Assurance (insurance); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.69.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster northa-prod-useast (EKS); External dependency: payments-svc calls a card payment provider (api.paysecure-gw.com) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
